subject: On‑prem VPC tenancy wiring acceptance and staging sanity

Date: 2027-03-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem VPC tenancy wiring acceptance and staging sanity

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We're preparing the staging rack handover next week and need a final wiring acceptance from Redwood before we flip the BGP sessions. Primary asks:

- Confirm control plane endpoint addresses and port expectations (TLS termination/ALPN) for the private control channel.
- Verify NAT egress behavior for inference nodes (source IP preservation and port ranges).
- Acceptance criteria for the canary (3 minute stability, 99.9% successful KV cache warmups, <120ms p95 local inference).
- Any post-cutover probing URLs/healthchecks we should run from our lab.

I've attached the current on‑prem wiring diagram (acme-vpc-wiring-v1.pdf) and a short snippet of our NAT test harness. Connectify will be on standby for the crossconnect.

Can we get confirmation by EOD Thursday? We're aiming for staging cutover Friday morning PST.

Thanks —
Samantha Nguyen
Lead Infrastructure Eng, Acme Corp
ops@acme-corp.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Connectify Networking <contact@connectify.net>
Date: 2027-03-02T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem VPC tenancy wiring acceptance and staging sanity

Samantha — thanks for the detail. Looping in Marissa (deploy ops), Laura (private deploy networking), and Neha (oncall/acceptance) to confirm specifics. Quick answers up front:

- Control plane: we will terminate TLS at the customer front proxy and Redwood controlplane will authenticate mutual TLS to the control endpoint on port 8443. We'll provide the SAN list (both internal names + VIP) in the next mail.
- NAT egress: inference worker egress will use a small, rotating ephemeral port range; source IP will be the customer NAT IP (we do not SNAT to Redwood-owned addresses).
- Canary: agree with your targets; we'll add KV warmup verification and an additional 1-minute tail latency stability window.
- Healthchecks: /healthz/control (443) and /healthz/infer (TCP/8080) — will share curl examples.

Attachments: acme-vpc-wiring-v1.pdf (from Acme), plus two internal snippets I'm attaching (nat-egress-snippet.txt and controlplane-san-list.txt).

I'll follow up with concrete config lines and BGP next-hop expectations.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-03T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem VPC tenancy wiring acceptance and staging sanity

Team — quick internal alignment before I reply to Acme with the acceptance checklist. Two operational clarifications from the runbook:

1) Controlplane SANs and IPs: we will accept TLS from the following VIPs: 10.111.5.12 (control-vip-1), 10.111.5.13 (control-vip-2) and the DNS names control.acme.internal + control-canary.acme.internal. This is to support both HA and canary split.

2) NAT egress ports: Redwood inference runtime will prefer ephemeral ports 49152–49250 for outbound token requests; please ensure your firewall allows that range to the internet egress cluster IPs. We will document a fallback if Connectify requires narrower windows.

3) BGP: Connectify will advertise the tenant prefixes; Redwood expects the next-hop to be the node facing Connectify. We will not overwrite next-hop. Please confirm Connectify's planned MP-BGP session cadence (we prefer 30s keepalive).

I'll add the above to the acceptance checklist and send to Samantha.

Marissa Cole
VP, Deploy Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Connectify Networking <contact@connectify.net>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-04T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem VPC tenancy wiring acceptance and staging sanity

Hi all — Connectify here. Confirming planned MP‑BGP parameters: keepalive 30s, holdtime 90s, advertised prefixes per attachment: 10.200.0.0/22 (tenant), 10.201.0.0/24 (management). We'll accept the next‑hop as presented by the colo-facing port; no next-hop rewrite.

We also suggest adding a short smoke test post-cutover: from Acme lab run 5 parallel inference requests for 2 minutes and validate token latency and model readiness. We'll provide the ASN details in a separate note.

— Connectify NOC
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@acme-corp.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, contact@connectify.net
Date: 2027-03-05T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem VPC tenancy wiring acceptance and staging sanity

Samantha — thanks. A few practical runbook items for the cutover window Friday:

- Pre-cutover (T-60m): Verify BGP session established and route table shows tenant prefixes in our table.
- T-15m: Start canary with a single node (traffic routed to control-canary.acme.internal). Validate KV warmups using the provided prompt set (we recommend the provided small prompt file).
- T+5m: Scale canary to 3 nodes and run the smoke test Connectify suggested (5 parallel requests for 2 minutes).
- Post-cutover (T+30m): Export heap/connection metrics and token-level telemetry to the shared drive link; we'll review for any anomalies.

I'll attach the curl commands and the healthcheck URLs in a separate email. If you confirm the firewall rules and Connectify's ASN, we can sign off on final acceptance.

Laura Bennett
Principal NetEng, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@acme-corp.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, contact@connectify.net
Date: 2027-03-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem VPC tenancy wiring acceptance and staging sanity

Thanks everyone — we have Connectify ASN 64532, firewall updated for ports 8443 and ephemeral 49152–49250, and tested BGP sessions (30s/90s) in the colo lab. We ran a short canary (single node) this morning: KV warmup succeeded and p95 inference was 112ms.

We're green to proceed with Friday morning staging flip. I'll upload the smoke logs to the Drive link and open the cutover change ticket in our system (CHG-ACME-1147).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Samantha
Lead Infrastructure Eng, Acme Corp
